The system shall find active property listing records by an exact, case-sensitive reference match and reject blank search references instead of returning the entire directory.
The system shall accept imported property listing descriptions only when they contain three to eighty printable ASCII characters and at least one non-space character.
The system shall normalize a property listing reference by removing surrounding ASCII spaces and uppercasing ASCII letters, rejecting empty references or insufficient output space.
The system shall display every returned property listing description with an Active or Archived badge, escape description text, and show an empty message when no records are returned.
